enablement.description: Required. The configured value of the enablement at the given resource. Possible values are: `ENABLED`, `DISABLED`.
enablement.security_impact: Medium. This controls whether quota adjuster is turned on or off for the project.
enablement.rationale: Implemented. A whitelist policy was written to allow only the approved enablement value. In this project, the policy was set to allow only `DISABLED` as the safer governance setting.

parent.description: The parent of the quota preference. Allowed parent format is "projects/[project-id / number]".
parent.security_impact: High. This controls which project scope is allowed to use quota adjuster settings.
parent.rationale: Implemented. A pattern whitelist policy was written so only approved project parents can be used.
